milestones.title: Somebody Retagged It
milestones.when: cloud: the container's tags were edited in the portal (needs the `cloud` event source); the `~` in `plan` is not read by the shell hook

milestones.title: It Vanished
milestones.joke: The container was deleted behind your back.
milestones.when: cloud: the container was deleted in the portal (needs the `cloud` event source)

milestones.title: Back in Business
milestones.when: shell: `tofu apply` (exit 0) after the portal delete (fires once `t7-delete` is earned, so it waits for the `cloud` event source)
